mark.not_kept: The papers for this one aren’t kept in this browser.
mark.not_kept_text: Open it once in the current app, or drop the download in there again, and it opens here too.
mark.page_bad: This page could not be read.
mark.which_rubric_text: The assignment card and this download’s saved work have different rubrics, so their scores would come out differently.
mark.wrap_drag: Drag to set where the text wraps
mark.page_width_tip: Wrap at the edge of the page
mark.comment_ph: Type a comment… Enter to finish, Shift Enter for a new line
mark.save_reuse_tip: Keep this comment so you can reuse it
mark.bank_saved: Saved. It’ll show up under every new comment.
mark.cannot: Not saved: this window can’t save just now
mark.m_once_tip: Drag once, then back to your tool
mark.comment_for_ph: Comment for the student (optional). It shows on the Grades tab so you can copy it.
mark.key_score: Score the row in hand (a full stop for the half)
mark.every_row: Every row has a score. To change one, click the row first.
mark.no_half: There’s no half on this scale.
mark.k_copied: Copied. Ctrl V puts it on the page you are looking at, on any student's paper.
mark.k_paste: Put the copied mark on this page
mark.k_dup: Make a copy of the picked mark
mark.k_letgo: Let go of the picked mark
mark.hl_snap_tip: Snaps to typed lines. Freehand on scans and handwriting. H switches.
mark.hl_snap_on: Highlight snaps to typed lines. Freehand where there are none.
mark.lf_flagged: Something here needs a look: a page to rescan, a grade on the paper to confirm, a score that differs from the paper, or a new or changed file
mark.list_fold: Fold the student list to a strip
mark.fb_text: Formative work gets feedback, not a score.
mark.fb_key: Feedback complete on or off (Shift: on, then the next student)
mark.stamp_tip: Put the score on the paper
mark.stamp_row: Put the {c} score on the paper
mark.stamp_open: Open the paper first, then stamp the score on it.
mark.stamp_where: Click on the paper where the score goes. Esc stops.
mark.cb_type_first: Type the comment first, then save it.
mark.cb_saved: Saved. It is one click away on every paper now.
mark.solo_tip: Shows just this student's work, for when they come to your desk
mark.k_snip: Screenshot: copy a picture of part of the screen
mark.sp_open: Side by side: keep a video, the rubric or another file beside the paper
mark.sp_key: Open or close the side pane
mark.sp_size_tip: Drag to make the side pane bigger or smaller. Double-click for the usual size.
mark.sp_no_words: Nothing is written yet for what each score means. Rubric setup has a box for each score.
mark.sp_nothing: There is nothing to show beside this paper yet. Add a video, another file or a rubric first.
mark.t_stamp: Stamps and stickers: tap the page for the menu (or hold a finger or pencil on it, or right-click)
mark.hn_sw_tip: Grade without names, in a random order
mark.hn_shuf_tip: Put the papers in a new random order
mark.setup_tip: The rubric, the files and the partners of this assignment
mark.win_reopened: Newer work from another window came in, so this assignment has been opened again.
mark.win_forgot: That assignment was forgotten in another window, so it’s closed here too.
mark.from_drive: Bringing the papers from your Google Drive: {n} of {of}
mark.cw_to_menu: No papers: just type the scores…

mark.cw_ud_say.one: Its assignment goes with it. Saved marks for that download stay in this browser.
mark.cw_ud_say.other: Its {n} assignments go with it. Saved marks for those downloads stay in this browser.

mark.cw_loose_say: Assignments with no class. Drag one onto a class in the sidebar, or use Move to… in its ⋯ menu.
